verdict.rationale: Any product with documentation could publish an llms.txt or agent-oriented docs, so this axis applies to ZCode. The pack contains no evidence that ZCode publishes either: the only probe, for a markdown version of the docs, returned HTTP 404, and the English docs mentioned by a community member are ordinary human-facing docs.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can point an agent at llms.txt or agent-oriented docs
